name: Potion of Healing
description: A red-glass vial filled with swirling liquid warmth.
rules: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Bag of Holding
description: A well-worn canvas bag that always feels light.
rules: This bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding 64 cubic feet.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: A polished ebony wand that vibrates with energy.
rules: This wand has 7 charges. Use an action to cast Magic Missile (1 charge per use).

name: Pearl of Power
description: A shimmering pearl that pulses with arcane power.
rules: Once per day, use an action to regain one expended spell slot (up to 3rd level).

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: A silvery, leafy cloak that shifts with the light.
rules: Advantage on Stealth checks; attackers have disadvantage on Perception checks to see you.

name: Flame Tongue
description: A sword with a burning red gem in the hilt.
rules: Speak a command word to ignite it. Adds 2d6 fire damage on hit.

name: Deck of Illusions
description: A stack of aged cards that flicker with phantasmal images.
rules: Draw a card to create an illusion of a creature. Lasts until dispelled.

name: Necklace of Fireballs
description: A golden chain holding glowing red beads.
rules: Each bead is a Fireball spell you can throw. Beads can be removed and used individually.

name: Broom of Flying
description: A sturdy wooden broom that thrums with arcane wind.
rules: The broom can carry up to 400 lbs and flies at 50 ft speed.
